'''Idu Taanfaar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] farmer from the the planet [[Kwevron]], who served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] as a contact during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], he was discovered and killed by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] under the command of [[Falto Dragen]].
